title: WhyKit provenance block
description: Optional front-matter block recording which system produced a note, without WhyKit having to model that system's internal state. Any producer may use it: a decision-support workflow, an agent framework, a migration script. Keys outside this list are allowed and ignored by the linter, so producers can extend it without a format change.

producer.description: Stable identifier of the producing system and its version, e.g. `example.decision-review/v1` or `whykit.adopt/0.2`.

producer_run.description: Identifier of the specific run, deliberation or import batch that produced this note.

payload_ref.description: Where the producer's own machine-readable record lives. WhyKit stores the durable human record; it deliberately does not mirror the producer's state machine.

snapshot_hash.description: Hash of the producer's immutable snapshot at the moment this note was written.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the producer wrote this note.

upstream.description: Identifiers of upstream artifacts the producer consumed, such as evidence packs.

human_reviewed.description: Whether a person reviewed this note after the producer wrote it. Agent-generated content cannot approve itself.
